The main takeaway from our work is that
Problematic Facebook use is a multifaceted construct that may be explained through both individual characteristics (such as personality traits) and social processes (such as social norms).

, in order to prevent the development of a new mental health problem, we should not only focus on the personal characteristics of the individual users, but also on the social factors influencing the use of Facebook.
